Iran's Supreme Leader Khamenei's Funeral Events Underway Amid Tensions

Funeral ceremonies for Iran's Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei are taking place in Iraq and Iran, following his death. The events occur amidst ongoing tensions between Iran and the US, with some Iranian experts stating Khamenei's death has united the people. Reports also mention a US-Israel war on Iran and a fragile Iran-US deal.
